source: stand-in: hand-written to show an emergency number written as one digit run, which the voice reads as a quantity rather than digit by digit (W3.14); not a model run.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha from Sunrise Family Clinic. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My father has sudden chest pain, what should I do?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please call the ambulance on 108 right now. The clinic cannot help with an emergency.
